name: Codebase analyst
description: For changes to a project that already exists: an analyst maps which files and functions the change touches before the Builder starts, and the Builder and QA get that map.

start.name: Codebase analyst
start.purpose: Reviews the code that already exists and shows exactly where the new feature has to change it.
reads: the existing code in this workspace
README and docs in this workspace
produces: .devcrew/codebase-review.md: overview, health findings, a change map per feature, and risks
